commentaries.author: Parimelazhagar
commentaries.text:
When someone can’t bear another’s gain, the goddess of fortune can’t bear that person either. She shows them to her elder sister and leaves. Some take அவ்வித்து to describe the envious person instead, whose mind has been made crooked.

செய்யவள், “the red one”, is the goddess of fortune. Her elder sister brings misfortune.
